answer: Under pair-distinctness lockstep enrollment, each identity in the fen network must simultaneously hold, for one live epoch, physical-aperture latency proofs on two mutually remote beacon channels, one a quartz oscillator link and one a crystal lattice sensor, and any two identities whose beacon-pair intersection overlaps are both slashed their full enrollment bond.
